setup_sentence_prediction_task: setup a Fairseq sentence prediction task with classification or regression targets using --num-classes
load_dataset_for_split: load a train, valid, or test dataset split for sentence classification with input and label data
build_classification_model: build a Fairseq model with a registered sentence classification head for num_classes targets
load_dictionary_with_mask: load a token dictionary from a dict.txt file and add a mask symbol for inputs or labels
add_task_args_to_parser: add sentence prediction task arguments like --num-classes, --init-token, and --separator-token to an argparse parser
